title: Peacock wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail fan -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='42' ry='30' fill='#1F6E4A'/>
    <ellipse cx='22' cy='50' rx='10' ry='16' fill='#2FA06A' transform='rotate(-25 22 50)'/>
    <ellipse cx='36' cy='40' rx='10' ry='17' fill='#2FA06A' transform='rotate(-12 36 40)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='10' ry='18' fill='#2FA06A'/>
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='40' rx='10' ry='17' fill='#2FA06A' transform='rotate(12 64 40)'/>
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='50' rx='10' ry='16' fill='#2FA06A' transform='rotate(25 78 50)'/>
    <!-- eyespots -->
    <circle cx='22' cy='48' r='5' fill='#FFC93C'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='36' r='5.5' fill='#FFC93C'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='6' fill='#FFC93C'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='36' r='5.5' fill='#FFC93C'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='48' r='5' fill='#FFC93C'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='48' r='2.4' fill='#2B4FA8'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='36' r='2.6' fill='#2B4FA8'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='2.8' fill='#2B4FA8'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='36' r='2.6' fill='#2B4FA8'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='48' r='2.4' fill='#2B4FA8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='12' ry='16' fill='#2B4FA8'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='12' height='20' rx='5' fill='#2B7FE0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='11' fill='#3FA0F0'/>
  <!-- crest feathers -->
  <g stroke='#7FD4FF' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='47' y1='26' x2='45' y2='19'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='25' x2='50' y2='17'/>
    <line x1='53' y1='26' x2='55' y2='19'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='45' cy='18' r='2' fill='#7FD4FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='2' fill='#7FD4FF'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='18' r='2' fill='#7FD4FF'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='50,38 62,41 50,44' fill='#FFB13B'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <g>
    <rect x='38' y='31' width='11' height='8' rx='2.5' fill='#1A2A5A'/>
    <rect x='51' y='31' width='11' height='8' rx='2.5' fill='#1A2A5A'/>
    <rect x='49' y='33' width='2' height='2' fill='#1A2A5A'/>
    <rect x='38' y='32' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8FE0FF'/>
    <rect x='51' y='32' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#8FE0FF'/>
  </g>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M46 83 l0 7 M46 90 l-4 3 M46 90 l4 3' stroke='#C98A2E' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 83 l0 7 M54 90 l-4 3 M54 90 l4 3' stroke='#C98A2E' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
